content: In the fine-tuning procedure, we follow the exact way the BERT performed. The output vectors are used to compute the score of tokens being start and end of the answer span. The valid span that has the maximum score is selected as the prediction. And similarly, the fine-tuning training was performed for 3 epochs with a learning rate of 3e-5.
